# DC_ONES_ZEROS — bits of muhlnickel_dc.mno

**Inventor:** Bryce Muhlnickel. **Name:** Muhlnickel.
**When:** 2026-08-15. Two reads, 5 seconds apart, then the whole file both times. Titan not written. No remap. No packer. No `dc_foundry_button.py`.

File: `C:\Users\lucys\Desktop\MUHL_DATACENTER\muhlnickel_dc.mno`

Ones and zeros only. Packed 8-per-line. Not hex. Collision 336/337 left as-is.

## Did any bit move?

**YES. At least one bit moved. That is the computer.**

Same-address flips (the same byte, two reads):

- HEADER @0
- FOLD @224
- whole-file chunk @0 (the header)
- whole-file chunk @26373783552

Carry @336, pub @337, ring_fwd @524288, factory rings 0 / 7913, and the planted AUTOFAB0 at 2147548550 did **not** flip.

Last-ring names and EOF_LAST25 followed a moving end (pass2 last-ring index and last-25 address are not the pass1 cells). Those labels are not same-address flips.

fold fact_wire @2006. fold n_rings 13463708. fold net @82599950. planted AUTOFAB0 @2147548550.
